notes (all optional):
- `/code-review` was the built-in skill and ran. I read the cited code for each finding.
- The abort listener left on the signal after a command answers is harmless, because `resume` ignores late calls.
- `ended` cannot reject today. `collect` ends in `catchCause`, and `notice` is pure.
- The comment on `release` and `session_shutdown` says "after every child has exited", but the guarantee is bounded by the 2 s grace. The comment should say so.
- `docs/pi/extensions.md` still says shutdown stops commands and does not mention the grace or `graceMs`. It needs a doc update.
- The deadline path can now block `before_agent_start` for up to the deadline plus the grace. This is accepted behavior and covered by a test.
- The removed success-path test left the `Exit.isSuccess` finalizer branch without a direct test. Other tests cover it only incidentally.
- The `settledSoon` 30 ms negative assertions can only give a false green under load, never a flaky failure. The positive assertions are deterministic. The deadline test is safe because sleeps only ever make it fire earlier.
- Not run, only read: a real child holding pipes on Windows.

evidence:
- Every previous blocker is closed and no child process outlives session_shutdown beyond the grace: `release` in `packages/integrations/pi/src/extension.ts` awaits every gather in the `running` set, and `session_shutdown` returns that promise. The tests for the stopped command and for the older compacted gather assert the shutdown stays pending until the child exits. The grace test shows the bound: shutdown resolves after `graceMs` for a command that never exits.
- The new tests fail on 0ca6337 and pass now, and none is vacuous or timing-fragile: 5 of the new tests fail on the base source and all 55 pass on 425f035 in 3 runs. The vacuous success test is removed. The deadline test margins are widened (100 ms steps against a 250 ms deadline).
- bunx --no-install mise run verify exits 0 and mise run build leaves the tree clean: verify exit 0 (1845 pass, 0 fail); build exit 0 and `git status --short` is empty before and after.
- checks-run: the verify, build, base-versus-new test and 3x repeat runs above. Logs are in `/tmp/claude-0/-home-user-holyagent/43946df6-456d-58c6-bea3-7e958fcb9495/scratchpad/verify.log` and `/tmp/claude-0/-home-user-holyagent/43946df6-456d-58c6-bea3-7e958fcb9495/scratchpad/build.log`.
